description.fun: Goomy is said to be the weakest Dragon-type Pokémon: a little slug that's mostly water, coated in a germ-laden slime that makes punches slide right off. If it dries out it can't breathe, so it sticks to damp, shady places, relying on the sensitive horns on its head to sense danger coming. Its name is all goo, gummy and slimy.
description.guide: Goomy is a Dragon-type Pokémon from Kalos resembling a small slug. Its body is mostly water and coated in slippery mucus that deflects physical attacks, but it must stay damp to survive. It evolves into Sliggoo and then Goodra, and in Hisui into their Hisuian forms.
description.tagline: The weakest dragon, a blob of slime with big ambitions

description.fun: Sliggoo is a blind snail with its brain and heart tucked inside a jelly 'shell'. Its slime dissolves anything, so it sprays prey and slurps them up, and since it can't see well, it sometimes tries to melt its friends by mistake. It's the only Pokémon whose evolution depends on the weather: it has to be raining before it becomes Goodra.
description.guide: Sliggoo is a Dragon-type Pokémon, the middle stage of Goomy's line, resembling a snail. It sprays a mucus that dissolves prey and senses the world through its horns, as its eyes have degenerated. It evolves into Goodra only when levelled up in the rain, and has a Steel-type Hisuian form.
description.tagline: A blind, slime-spraying snail that only evolves in the rain

description.fun: A gloomy-eyed snail in a spiral iron shell, formed when its slime reacted with Hisui's iron-rich water. It peeks out only its head and arms, rolls away inside the shell when it's in a hurry, and floats on water in it.

Goodra is a big softie among dragons: it shows affection by hugging people and leaving them coated in slime, cries gooey tears when left alone, and often misunderstands instructions in a way Trainers find adorable. Push it too far, though, and its retractable horns hit 100 times harder than a heavyweight boxer. It may come from the Lou Carcolh, a slimy serpent of French folklore.
description.guide: Goodra is a Dragon-type Pokémon, the final form of Goomy. It is gentle and affectionate, coated in slime that makes attacks slide off, but its horns and tail strike hard when it's provoked. Hisui has a Steel-type Hisuian Goodra with a metal shell.
description.tagline: A slimy dragon whose hugs are sticky and sincere

names.ja: ヒスイ ヌメルゴン

description.fun: Thinner, with a big iron shell whose hardness it controls at will. It's clingy and goes on a rampage if its friends leave, and when things go wrong it hides in its shell and bounces off like a rubber ball, hard enough to flatten trees.

note.text: In Hisui, Goomy evolves into Hisuian Sliggoo instead: its slime reacts with the region's iron-rich water and builds a metal shell, which adds the Steel type.
